label: LA

notes.grounding: Option loop, Overall Completion line, unconditional exit 0, bc guard exiting 1, OVERALL_PERCENTAGE set only by calculate_spec_completeness all match the script. Minor: --file mode claim ignores that OVERALL_PERCENTAGE defaults to 100 at line 67; the exit-3 taxonomy claim is external and unverified; no line numbers cited for edit sites.
notes.requirements: Exit 3 below, exit 0 at or above, output unchanged, non-integer/out-of-range exits 1 are all testable. A missing value after --min-percent is not specified in spec.md (only plan.md testing lists it), and the at-equal boundary has no acceptance check.
notes.verification: Every task has a Verify clause, but the below-threshold checks assume the packet has placeholders; running the real script on these docs gives Overall Completion 100% with 0 placeholders, so --min-percent 100 would exit 0 and T007 would fail on a correct implementation. T004's rg pattern is a regex parse error. T002 is vacuous. No task tests N equal to the figure, so -le vs -lt is not caught; no missing-value check.
notes.scope: Stays on the one option, no invented subsystems, no filler, no unfilled tokens.
notes.consistency: Ids, paths and exit codes agree. plan.md testing lists -1 and a missing value that neither spec.md nor tasks.md carry, and plan Step 3 refers to 'four invocations' in Phase 3, which holds six tasks.
notes.clarity: A developer could implement it: parse, validate 0-100 integer, exit 1 on bad input, compare after output, --file mode exits 0. Missing-value handling is left to the implementer, and under set -u a bare --min-percent would hit an unbound $2.

defects: tasks.md:48: T007 verify expects exit 3 with --min-percent 100, but the packet has 0 placeholders (real script reports Overall Completion: 100%), so a correct implementation prints 0
spec.md:90: SC-001 relies on placeholders remaining in the packet; none match the script's patterns, so the criterion cannot be observed
tasks.md:45: T004 verify pattern '--min-percent\\)' is a ripgrep regex parse error (unopened group) and would not match the case branch
tasks.md:36: T002 verify 'rg ... | tail -1 prints one line' is vacuous; tail -1 always prints at most one line and does not confirm the edit sites (script has exit 0 at lines 95 and 587)
tasks.md:58: no task tests N equal to the reported figure, so an off-by-one (-le instead of -lt) passes all checks; plan.md:101 lists that case but tasks drop it
spec.md:81: REQ-005 does not specify behavior for a missing value after --min-percent; plan.md:103 lists it but no requirement or task covers it
spec.md:114: says --file mode never sets OVERALL_PERCENTAGE, but the global is initialized to 100 at script line 67
plan.md:90: Step 3 says 'the four invocations in tasks.md Phase 3' but Phase 3 holds six tasks (T008-T013)
spec.md:105: exit-3 'system error' taxonomy claim is not grounded in calculate-completeness.sh, which documents only exit 0 and 1
